### addCorrective

Turn a sculpt of the posed mesh into a corrective morph target. The fix is taken back through the skin into rest space (pose-space inversion) so it applies before skinning and matches the sculpt at this pose, and a pose driver reading each driver joint against its rest drives the weight: 1 at this pose, 0 at rest. Several drivers multiply (a combination corrective). Give the sculpt then the base (the base can be left out for a sculpt made by sculptCorrective). Returns {target, drivers, residual}.

**Objects:** sculpt, base?

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `driver` | `d` | Any |  | Joint name or list of joints. Default: the skin's most rotated influence. |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | The target's name. Default: <driver>_corrective. |
| `axis` |  | str | `'x'` | Each driver's twist axis (its bone axis). One of `x`, `y`, `z`. |
| `radius` |  | float | `0.0` | Degrees from the pose where the weight reaches 0; 0 uses the rest-to-pose angle. |
| `twistWeight` |  | float | `0.0` | How much twist about the axis counts, 0 ignoring it. |
| `falloff` |  | str | `'smooth'` | linear \| smooth \| smoother |
| `keep` |  | bool | `False` | Keep the sculpt mesh instead of deleting it. |

### addModifier

Add a modifier to the top of a mesh's stack. params sets its parameters. Returns its name. modifierKinds(docs=True) also lists kinds extensions add later.

Kinds:
- array: Repeats the mesh in a row, each copy shifted by a fixed step. Use it for railings, stairs, tiles and other evenly spaced repeats.
- autoBevel: Bevels the fold edges it finds live on its input by angle, side and length rules, plus edges picked by hand. Use it for game-art bevels that keep following the mesh as you edit it.
- bevel: Bevels every edge sharper than an angle so hard corners catch the light. A quick live bevel; Auto Bevel has finer edge rules and hand-picked edges.
- boolean: A boolean kept live: cuts, joins or intersects this mesh with a cutter mesh, so moving or editing the cutter updates the result. Stack one per cutter. Apply bakes it.
- decimate: Reduces the triangle count while keeping the shape, silhouette, UVs and normals. Use it for LODs or to lighten scans and sculpts.
- extrude: Extrudes faces, or grows strips off edges, kept live: the faces or edges selected when it was added follow later edits under it, and its thickness and offset stay adjustable. Without a selection it extrudes every face.
- mirror: Adds a mirrored copy across a plane through the object's origin and welds the seam. Model one half of a symmetrical object and let this build the other.
- solidify: Gives a surface thickness: an inner shell offset along the normals, joined to the outer one at open borders. Use it to turn planes and open shells into solid panels.
- subdivision: Smooths the mesh with Catmull-Clark subdivision. Use it to turn a low-poly cage into a smooth high-poly surface.
- transferAttributes: Transfer Attributes kept live: copies UVs, normals, color sets, positions or named layers from a source mesh, so editing or moving the source updates this mesh without baking. Apply bakes the result.
- triangulate: Splits every face into triangles. Use it to see, or lock in, the triangulation an engine will get.
- weightedNormals: Weights vertex normals by face area so big flat faces shade flat and the bevels take the curvature. Use it on bevelled hard-surface game meshes.

**Objects:** mesh

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` |  | str |  | Modifier kind, such as bevel or mirror (see Kinds). |
| `params` |  | Any |  | {param: value} to set on the new modifier. |

### applyLibraryMaterial

Put a library material on meshes: faces= of one object, the face selection, else whole objects (default the selection). Faces get a new material slot; whole objects keep their one bound slot or get a new one. The slot's texture set takes the material's graph, tiled so one tile spans the material's scaleCm on the surface (from the meshes' uv texel density). With set= and no objects, replaces that set's graph. Returns {set, material, tiles, uvPerCm}.

**Objects:** material [objects...]

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `faces` | `f` | list |  | Face ids of the one object given. |
| `slot` |  | str |  | Bind to this existing material slot instead of picking one. |
| `set` |  | str |  | Apply to this texture set (and the meshes using its material). |
| `preset` |  | str |  | A preset of the material's parameters to apply. |
| `values` |  | Any |  | {"Node.param": value} to set after the preset. |
| `scale` |  | bool | `True` | Tile to real-world size; False keeps one tile per uv unit. |
| `tiles` |  | float |  | Tiles per uv unit, overriding the real-world scale. |
| `layer` |  | bool | `False` | Add it as a layer on top of the set's layer stack instead of replacing the set's graph. |

Synchronous and cancellable (async=True returns at once and bakes off the main thread). dryRun=True only plans the files. Returns {outputs, stats (samples, hits, misses, backfaces, per group), warnings, manifest, seconds, timings (seconds per stage), backend, backendMode}.

### bakeArrange

Toggle the Arrange display: a project's groups drawn side by side along X (by their bounds) for inspection, each group's lows, highs and cage moved together. View only: scene meshes never move, the scene file doesn't change and bakes always run where the meshes are. on= sets it instead of toggling; reset=True turns it off. Returns {arranged, offsets: {group: [x, y, z]}}.

### bakeCage

A bake group's editable cage. create=True duplicates the low pushed out by the auto cage (frontal x cageOffset x the painted bakeOffset) as a mesh the group then uses; edit its points freely, its topology must stay the low's. fromPaint=True moves an existing cage to the auto cage as painted now. reset=True goes back to the auto cage (delete=True also removes the cage mesh). With no flag, reports the cage and whether it matches the low.

**Objects:** group (or its low; default the selection)

| `fromPaint` | `fp` | bool | `False` | Move the cage's points to the painted auto cage. |
| `reset` | `rs` | bool | `False` | Use the auto cage again. |
| `delete` | `del` | bool | `False` | With reset: delete the cage mesh too. |

### bakeEstimateCage

Estimate a bake group's cage in one step: paints bakeOffset on its lows so every texel's ray starts just outside the high and meets it, and sets the group's frontal and rear distances (an editable cage moves to the result). Checks itself by tracing the lows as a bake would, growing the cage where rays still miss. One undo step. Returns the miss rates before and after.

**Objects:** group (or its low; default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `resolution` | `res` | int | `512` | Texels per side of the coverage check. |
| `iterations` | `it` | int | `4` | Coverage passes that may grow the cage. |
| `margin` | `mg` | float | `0.004` | Gap kept between cage and high, as a fraction of the lows' bounds diagonal. |
| `apply` | `ap` | bool | `True` | Write the result; False only reports it. |

### bakeGroup

Create or edit a bake group: the lows that receive maps and the highs projected onto them. A group only traces its own highs, so groups overlapping in space never affect each other, and several groups can write into one texture. Each high carries a bake-only modifier stack (modifiers= or preset=, e.g. "Smooth x2") evaluated into the bake's snapshot only: nothing is added to the scene. self=True bakes the lows onto themselves through such a stack. Creates the group (and a project) when the name is new. Returns the group.

**Objects:** [group]

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project` | `pj` | str |  | The bake project; defaults to the scene's only one. |
| `lows` | `lo` | list |  | Replace the lows. |
| `highs` | `hi` | list |  | Replace the highs (mesh names). |
| `addLow` | `al` | list |  | Add lows. |
| `removeLow` | `rl` | list |  | Remove lows. |
| `addHigh` | `ah` | list |  | Add highs. |
| `removeHigh` | `rh` | list |  | Remove highs. |
| `self` | `sf` | bool |  | Add (True) or remove (False) the lows themselves as a high. |
| `modifiers` | `md` | Any |  | Bake-only modifier stack, [{"kind": "subdivision", "params": {"levels": 2}}] or a preset name, for the highs given in this call (else every high). Kinds are modifierKinds(). |
| `preset` | `ps` | str |  | A bake modifier preset instead of modifiers=: Smooth x2, Smooth x1-x4, Auto Bevel + Smooth, none. |
| `cage` | `cg` | str |  | A cage mesh with the low's topology (one low); empty uses the auto cage. |
| `cageOffset` | `co` | float |  | Scales the auto cage's push (frontal distance). |
| `frontal` | `fd` | float |  | How far outside the low rays start, cm; 0 is auto (measured against the highs). |
| `rear` | `rd` | float |  | How far inside the low rays reach, cm; 0 is auto (measured against the highs). |

| `skew` | `sk` | float |  | 0 to 1: tilts rays from the smooth normals toward each low face's normal. |
| `addHighFile` | `ahf` | list |  | Add highs streamed from files at bake time (.fbx, .obj, .abc), never loaded into the scene. |

### bakeGroupPerMesh

One bake group per mesh: each given (or selected) mesh becomes the low of its own group, so meshes that overlap or share a UV sheet still bake in isolation. Highs come from _high/_hi/_HP names matching the mesh's base name; a mesh without one bakes onto itself (self) through preset= (e.g. Smooth x2). A mesh already a low of a group of the project keeps that group. Returns the groups.

**Objects:** [meshes]

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project` | `pj` | str |  | The bake project; created when the scene has none. |
| `preset` | `ps` | str |  | Bake modifier preset for self highs (Smooth x2, Auto Bevel + Smooth). |

### bakeLint

Check a bake project before baking: hard edges off UV seams, overlapping UVs (also across groups writing one texture), missing or degenerate UVs, texel density outliers, mirrored islands against tangent signs, lows with no high in range, highs outside the cage, non-planar faces whose triangulation depends on the exporter, and cage topology. bake runs it first and lists its warnings. Returns {issues: [{check, severity, group, mesh, message, data}], warnings, checks, distances: [{group, frontal, rear, frontalAuto, rearAuto, measured}]} (Auto distances are measured against the highs when highs is on).

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project` | `pj` | str |  | The bake project; defaults to the scene's only one. |
| `groups` | `g` | list |  | Lint only these groups. |
| `checks` | `c` | list |  | Run only these checks (the names in checks of the result). |
| `highs` | `hi` | bool | `True` | Load the highs for the range and cage checks (False is quick: low checks only). |
| `backend` | `be` | str | `'cpu'` | Backend tracing the range check's rays. |

Not undoable.

### bakeLiveMaps

Live mesh maps: keeps a bake project's maps on the GPU at a preview resolution, for texture graphs and the viewport, and rebakes only the texel tiles an edit to a low or cage touches. enable=True starts (or reconfigures) it, disable=True drops it, update=True rebakes what changed now and waits; with none of them, returns the status.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project` | `pj` | str |  | The bake project; defaults to the scene's only one. |
| `enable` | `e` | bool | `False` | Start, or restart with these options. |
| `disable` | `d` | bool | `False` | Stop and drop the images. |
| `update` | `u` | bool | `False` | Snapshot now and rebake what changed, waiting for it; returns the update's stats. |
| `maps` | `m` | list |  | Map ids from the project's list; default every enabled map the GPU bakes. |
| `groups` | `g` | list |  | Bake groups to include; default all of the project's. |
| `resolution` | `r` | int | `0` | Texels per side; 0 uses the bake/liveResolution pref (1024). |
| `supersampling` | `ss` | int | `0` | Samples per texel (1, 4, 16, 64); 0 uses the bake/liveSupersampling pref (1). |
| `padding` | `pd` | int | `-1` | Dilation in texels; -1 scales the project's padding to the resolution. |
| `debounce` | `db` | int | `-1` | Milliseconds of quiet after an edit before rebaking; -1 uses the bake/liveDebounceMs pref. |
| `set` | `st` | str |  | The set: empty for the project's own, cagePreview for the cage view's. |

Not undoable.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `map` | `m` | str |  | Only this map id. |
| `udim` | `ud` | int |  | Only this UDIM tile. |
| `low` | `lo` | str |  | Only this low (node path). |
| `set` | `st` | str |  | The set: empty for the project's own, cagePreview for the cage view's. |

Not undoable.

### bakePaint

Paint a low's bake cage attributes: offset (bakeOffset, scales the auto cage push per point, 1 unpainted) or skew (bakeSkew, added to the group's skew, tilts rays toward the face normal). op add, subtract, smooth or set, at points=, within radius of center= (world space), or flood=True everywhere (the component selection in component mode). symmetry mirrors across an axis. One undo step. Returns the attribute's min, max and mean.

**Objects:** mesh (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `attr` | `at` | str | `'offset'` | offset or skew. |
| `op` | `o` | str | `'set'` | add, subtract, smooth or set. |
| `value` | `v` | float | `1.0` | The amount to add or subtract, or the value to set. |
| `strength` | `st` | float | `1.0` | 0 to 1: how far each dab moves toward its result. |
| `points` | `pt` | list |  | Point ids to paint at full weight. |
| `center` | `ce` | tuple[float, float, float] |  | World-space brush centre; points within radius get a smooth falloff. |
| `radius` | `r` | float |  | World-space brush radius, cm. |
| `flood` | `fl` | bool | `False` | Apply to every point (or the selected components). |
| `symmetry` | `sy` | str | `'none'` | Mirror across x, y or z (object space). One of `none`, `x`, `y`, `z`. |

### batchRename

Rename many objects at once: a new name, find/replace (plain or regex, $1 for groups), strip, case, prefix and suffix, in that order. In name, replace, prefix and suffix '#' runs number the objects (## is 01, 02...), and {name}, {parent} and {type} insert the original name, the parent's name and the node type. Defaults to the selection. Returns [{path, from, to, status}], status one of renamed, unchanged, reference, empty, clash (Lila numbers it).

**Objects:** objects

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` |  | str |  | Replaces each whole name, e.g. tail_## for tail_01, tail_02... |
| `find` |  | str |  | Text or pattern to find; empty skips find/replace. |
| `replace` |  | str |  | What each match becomes. |
| `regex` |  | bool | `False` | find is an ECMAScript regular expression. |
| `matchCase` |  | bool | `False` | find is case-sensitive. |
| `stripStart` |  | int | `0` | Characters to drop from the front. |
| `stripEnd` |  | int | `0` | Characters to drop from the back. |
| `stripDigits` |  | bool | `False` | Drop the trailing number and the separator before it. |
| `case` |  | str |  | PascalCase, camelCase, snake_case, UPPER_SNAKE, lower or UPPER; empty keeps it. |
| `prefix` |  | str |  | Added in front. |
| `suffix` |  | str |  | Added at the end. |
| `start` |  | int | `1` | The number '#' gives the first object. |
| `step` |  | int | `1` | How much '#' goes up per object. |
| `hierarchy` |  | bool | `False` | Include every descendant of the objects. |
| `order` |  | str | `'selection'` | Numbering order: selection, or outliner (top to bottom). |
| `preview` |  | bool | `False` | Report what would change without renaming. |

### batchRun

Run a Python script over many scene files, each opened in its own lilabatch worker, several at once. The script sees ctx: ctx.file, ctx.output, ctx.index, ctx.args (scriptArgs), ctx.results (a dict collected into the summary and CSV), ctx.save = False to leave a file unsaved, ctx.skip(reason). Returns the run's summary (with files once finished): {id, state, total, counts, seconds, dir, csv, files}.

**Objects:** files, folders or globs

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `script` | `s` | str |  | Python source to run in every file. ctx (lila.batch.BatchContext) is in its globals. |
| `scriptFile` | `sf` | str |  | A .py file to run instead; tracebacks point into it. |
| `sceneScript` | `ss` | str |  | Run a script saved in the open scene, by name. |
| `recursive` | `r` | bool |  | Walk folders all the way down. Default: only the folder itself. |
| `depth` | `d` | int |  | How many folder levels to walk below each input folder; -1 for all. |
| `extensions` | `ext` | list |  | File types folders are searched for ("ma", ".lila"). Default: every type Lila opens. |
| `include` | `inc` | list |  | Globs a file must match (name, or path below its folder when it has a slash). |
| `exclude` | `exc` | list |  | Globs that leave a file out. |
| `excludePrefix` | `xp` | str |  | Leave out files whose name starts with this. |
| `excludeSuffix` | `xs` | str |  | Leave out files whose name (without extension) ends with this. |
| `excludeContains` | `xc` | str |  | Leave out files whose name contains this. |
| `fileList` | `fl` | str |  | Add the files of a saved file list (batchRunFileList). |
| `save` | `sv` | str |  | none (default), overwrite (in place; other formats save as .lila beside them) or saveAs. |
| `outputDir` | `o` | str |  | saveAs: the folder to write to. Default: beside each source. |
| `suffix` | `sx` | str |  | saveAs: added to each file name ("_fixed"). |
| `format` | `fmt` | str |  | saveAs: lila or lilaa. Default: the source's, .lila for other formats. |
| `keepTree` | `kt` | bool |  | saveAs: mirror the folders below each input folder under outputDir. Default on. |
| `checkout` | `co` | str |  | auto (default) checks read-only files out through source control; never leaves them. |
| `makeWritable` | `mw` | bool |  | Clear the read-only flag of files source control does not take. |
| `workers` | `w` | int |  | Files processed at once, each in its own lilabatch. Default 0: half the cores, at most 8. |
| `stopOnError` | `soe` | bool |  | Start no more files after one fails. Default: carry on. |
| `timeout` | `to` | float |  | Seconds a file may take before its worker is ended; 0 for no limit. |
| `dryRun` | `dry` | bool |  | Only report the plan: each file, where it saves and whether it can be written. |
| `scriptArgs` | `sa` | Any |  | A dict handed to the script as ctx.args. |
| `csv` |  | str |  | Write the summary table here when the run finishes. |
| `preset` | `p` | str |  | Start from a saved preset (batchRunPreset); flags given here override it. |
| `wait` |  | bool |  | Block until the run finishes. Default: wait in batch mode, return at once with a UI. |

Not undoable.

### boundingMesh

Wrap the selection's points in a fitted shape, ready to go to Unreal as collision. Orientation is solved from the points alone (minimum-volume box), so frozen and unfrozen geometry behave the same, and every point is inside. Works on objects (every mesh at or under them) or on selected components. Returns the new meshes.

**Objects:** objects

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shape` | `s` | str | `'box'` | box, sphere, capsule, cylinder or hull. |
| `offset` | `o` | float | `0.0` | Padding pushed out on every side, cm. |
| `axisOffset` | `ao` | tuple[float, float, float] |  | Extra padding per box axis, added to offset, cm. |
| `orient` | `or` | str | `'fit'` | fit (tightest box from the points), world or object (the owner's axes). |
| `axis` | `ax` | str | `'auto'` | Axis a capsule or cylinder runs along: auto (smallest), x, y or z of the box. |
| `perObject` | `po` | bool | `False` | One shape per mesh instead of one around everything. |
| `nameFromSelection` | `ns` | bool | `True` | Name after the mesh it wraps, so Unreal pairs it as that mesh's collision. |
| `name` | `n` | str | `'Collision'` | Base name when not named from the selection. |
| `prefix` | `p` | str | `'auto'` | Put before the name; auto picks Unreal's: UBX_, USP_, UCP_, or UCX_ for cylinders and hulls. |
| `parent` | `pa` | bool | `True` | Parent under the mesh it wraps, keeping it in place. |
| `segments` | `sg` | int | `16` | Segments around a sphere, capsule or cylinder. |
| `maxHullPoints` | `mh` | int | `32` | Most points a hull keeps. |
| `generator` | `g` | bool | `False` | Keep the primitive's generator so its size stays editable. |

### centerJoint

Move each joint (or any node with centerInMesh/centerMeshes attrs) to the centre of the mesh cross-section across its bone: the meshes are cut by the plane through the joint perpendicular to parent->joint (or joint->first child), and the joint moves to the area centroid of the loop it sits in, or the nearest loop. Meshes come from centerMeshes, else the skinClusters it influences. Returns the nodes moved.

### editSkeleton

Edit a bound skeleton without deforming its mesh. on=True puts the skeleton (of the given meshes or joints, else every skinned one) in bind pose and holds its animation; move, orient and re-pivot joints freely, then on=False rebinds the skins to the new joints and re-expresses the animation for them. preserve="worldPose" keeps every joint's world placement at each key (a moved joint keeps its move); "channels" keeps the raw key values. Without on, toggles. Returns whether editing is on.

Euler filter the rotate curves of transforms (default the selection): each key keeps its rotation but takes the angles closest to the previous key's, removing flips and 360-degree jumps. Rotation curves need none. Returns the number of keys changed.

### exportFbx

Export the evaluated meshes and transforms to a binary FBX 7.4 file. Objects default to the selection (or the whole scene with selectionOnly=False). Names go out intact, so UCX_/UBX_/USP_/UCP_ collision and SOCKET_ empties work in Unreal. kind=skeletal writes joints, skins (bind pose mesh, clusters, BindPose), morph targets (in-betweens as their own targets) with their weight curves, driven channel curveNames as named curves on the root joint, and the animation baked over the range; kind=animation writes only the skeleton and its curves. kind=sequence writes cameras and transforms with their animation and no meshes, for Unreal Sequencer's Import FBX: cameras go out as FBX cameras (focal length aperture mode, film back, clipping, focal length and clipping curves) and arrive as CineCameras. Cameras are written as FBX cameras in every kind. start/end are frames. Returns the path.

**Objects:** path objects...

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `profile` |  | str | `'ue5'` | Axis profile: ue5 (Z up), ue6 (Y up) or generic (the scene's own axes). |
| `kind` | `k` | str | `'auto'` | auto \| static \| skeletal \| animation \| sequence. auto is skeletal when a skinned mesh is exported, sequence when only cameras are. |
| `maxInfluences` | `mi` | int | `8` | Skin influences per vertex, heaviest kept and renormalised (4 for mobile). |
| `animation` | `anim` | bool | `True` | Write the take for skeletal and sequence exports (always for kind=animation). |
| `bakeAnimation` | `bake` | bool | `True` | Sample every frame; False writes plain translate/rotate/scale curves as keys. |
| `deformOnly` | `do` | bool | `True` | Skeletal and animation kinds: deform joints only (IK helpers and rig-only joints stay behind). |
| `start` | `st` | float |  | First frame; the playback start by default. |
| `end` | `et` | float |  | Last frame; the playback end by default. |
| `take` |  | str |  | Take (AnimStack) name; the active take's, else Take 001. |
| `takes` |  | Any |  | Scene takes to write, one AnimStack each: 'all' or a list of names. |
| `triangulate` |  | bool | `True` | Write triangles exactly as the viewport splits faces. |
| `tangents` |  | bool | `True` | Write MikkTSpace tangents and binormals from uv0. |
| `worldSpace` | `ws` | bool | `False` | Bake world transforms into the meshes and flatten the hierarchy. |
| `atOrigin` |  | bool | `False` | Drop the exported roots' own transforms, keeping their children relative. |
| `children` |  | bool | `True` | Include the descendants of the given objects. |

### fullBodyIk

Pose a whole skeleton so each pinned joint reaches its target. The motion spreads over the joints between the pins and the hips by stiffness; everything else keeps its pose. Writes the joints' rotate (and the hips' translate) as FK. Returns {'error': the largest pin miss in cm}.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pins` | `p` | list |  | [{'joint': name, 'position': [x, y, z], 'rotation': [x, y, z], 'weight': 1.0}], world space; rotation is XYZ Euler degrees. position and rotation are each optional. |
| `hold` | `h` | list |  | Joints pinned where they are now (position and rotation). |
| `root` | `r` | str |  | Top joint of the skeleton to solve; default the first pin's top joint. |
| `stiffness` | `st` | Any |  | {joint: 0..1}: how much each joint resists turning, so its neighbours take the motion. |
| `moveRoot` | `mr` | bool | `True` | Let the hips move when turning joints is not enough. |
| `key` | `k` | bool | `False` | Key the posed joints. |

Export everything, the selection, or object sets to FBX or OBJ, as one file, a file per set or a file per object. Returns the paths written, or with dryRun=True [{file, nodes}] without writing.

### ikChain

Make an IK chain from a start joint to an end effector, solved by a base ikHandle. The joints keep their keyed rotate: grabbing the controller solves the chain and writes (keys) the rotations, and a locked key holds the controller until the chain's next key. Returns the chain.

**Objects:** startJoint endJoint

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startJoint` | `sj` | str |  | First joint. |
| `endJoint` | `ej` | str |  | End effector. |
| `solver` | `sol` | str |  | IK solver; default ik2BoneSolver for three joints, else FABRIK. |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Chain name; default <effector>_ik. |
| `poleVector` | `pv` | tuple[float, float, float] |  | Bend direction from the start joint; default the chain's current bend. |
| `parent` | `p` | str |  | Node to put the element under, such as a character. |

### ikHandle

Create an IK handle that solves the chain from startJoint down to endEffector (or the first and last selected joints); the handle starts on the end joint, so nothing moves. The joints keep their keyable rotate as FK and the handle's ikBlend crossfades to the solution. With refresh=True, re-reads the rest layout of the given handles' chains after joints were edited. Returns the handle.

**Objects:** handles (refresh only)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startJoint` | `sj` | str |  | First joint of the chain. |
| `endEffector` | `ee` | str |  | Last joint of the chain; the one placed on the handle. |
| `solver` | `sol` | str |  | IK solver id; empty picks ik2BoneSolver for three joints, else ikFabrikSolver. |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Handle name. |
| `poleVector` | `pv` | tuple[float, float, float] |  | Bend direction from the start joint; defaults to the chain's current bend. |
| `poleAngle` | `pa` | float |  | Roll of the bend plane, degrees. |
| `refresh` | `rf` | bool | `False` | Re-read the rest layout of the given handles' chains. |

### ikLock

Lock (plant) or unlock the key at a time on IK and reverse foot controllers: a locked key holds the controller where it is, and the solver holds the hand or foot there, until the chain's next key. Toggles without state. Returns each chain's new state.

**Objects:** IK chains, their controllers or joints in them

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `time` | `t` | float |  | Seconds; default the current time. |
| `state` | `s` | bool |  | Locked or not; default the opposite of now. |

### importFbx

Import an FBX file: its node hierarchy as transforms, joints and meshes, converted to the scene's axes and cm. LimbNodes become joints (PreRotation into jointOrient), skins become skinClusters with the file's weights and bind matrices, morph channels become a morph with a target per channel (in-betweens kept), and one take is baked onto the channels. Cameras become camera nodes with their lens, film back and clipping (focal length, film back and clipping curves keyed per frame); lights are reported, not imported. Returns the new node names, or with report=True a dict of nodes, roots, joints, skinClusters, take, fps, skipped and warnings.

**Objects:** path

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `parent` | `p` | str |  | Parent the imported roots under this node. |
| `skins` |  | bool | `True` | Rebuild skins as joints and skinClusters with their weights and bind pose. |
| `animation` | `anim` | bool | `True` | Bake the take onto translate/rotate/scale, one key per frame. |
| `take` |  | str |  | AnimStack to import; the file's active one (or first) by default. |
| `setPlayback` |  | bool | `True` | Set the scene fps and playback range from the take. |
| `report` |  | bool | `False` | Return the import report instead of just the names. |
| `select` |  | bool | `True` | Select the imported roots. |

### lodGroup

Make an LOD group from objects (LOD0 first, in order), or edit the LOD group named. Returns the group's path.

With generate, LOD0 (one mesh) gets that many reduced copies as the next levels. Unreal imports the group as one mesh with these LODs.

**Objects:** objects (LOD0 first), or one lodGroup to edit

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Group name, and the base of the levels' names. Defaults to LOD0's name without any _LODn. |
| `screenSizes` | `ss` | Any |  | Unreal LOD screen size per level, like [1, 0.5, 0.25]; [] uses Unreal's automatic sizes. |
| `generate` | `g` | int | `0` | Reduced copies of LOD0 to add as further levels. |
| `ratio` | `r` | float | `0.5` | Triangles each generated level keeps of the one before, 0 to 1. |
| `autoName` | `an` | bool |  | Rename the levels <name>_LOD0, <name>_LOD1, ... On by default when creating. |

```python
lodGroup("Rock_LOD0", "Rock_LOD1", "Rock_LOD2", screenSizes=[1, 0.4, 0.15])
```

```python
lodGroup("Rock", generate=3, ratio=0.5)
```

### materialLint

Check a material's values against physical ranges: a texture set, a library id or a .lilamat path, evaluated small. Convert Maya files to Lila scenes: a file to a .lila / .lilaa, or every .ma / .mb in a folder. Each file is opened as its own scene and saved; the scene is left empty afterwards. Returns one entry per file with its destination (or error), skipped features and warnings.

| `references` |  | Any | `'reference'` | reference: referenced Maya / FBX / OBJ files become Lila references (Maya and FBX ones converted to a .lila beside them) with the scene's reference edits as overrides; import: their nodes as ordinary scene nodes; none: skip them. |
| `history` |  | bool | `True` | Keep a lone primitive creator (polyCube ...) as a live generator node. |

### meshRepair

Find or fix broken geometry. mode='select' selects what each enabled check finds and reports the counts; mode='repair' fixes it: welds coincident points, collapses zero-length edges, drops lamina copies, merges zero-area slivers into a neighbour, splits non-manifold edges and vertices apart, fills holes, cuts n-gons and concave faces into quads and triangles, conforms winding, removes loose points and edges.

**Objects:** objects

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` |  | str | `'repair'` | select: select the problems instead of fixing them. Points, edges and faces are each selected in their own component mode, and the mode switches to whichever kind has the most; the log lists the counts per check. repair: fix them. |
| `coincident` |  | bool | `True` | Points closer than the tolerance to another (repair welds them). |
| `zeroLengthEdges` |  | bool | `True` | Edges shorter than the tolerance (repair collapses them). |
| `lamina` |  | bool | `True` | Faces built on exactly the points of another face (repair deletes the extra copy). |
| `zeroAreaFaces` |  | bool | `True` | Faces thinner than the tolerance (repair merges each into the face across its longest edge). |
| `nonManifoldEdges` |  | bool | `True` | Edges shared by three or more faces (repair splits the extra faces off). |
| `nonManifoldVertices` |  | bool | `True` | Vertices where separate fans of faces meet, like a bowtie (repair gives each fan its own vertex). |
| `holes` |  | bool | `False` | Edges on an open border (repair fills each hole with a face). Off by default: open meshes are often meant to be. |
| `ngons` |  | bool | `False` | Faces with more than four sides (repair triangulates them and joins the triangles back into convex quads where they fit). |
| `concave` |  | bool | `False` | Faces with a corner bending inward (repair cuts them into convex quads and triangles). |
| `zeroAreaUvs` |  | bool | `False` | Faces with no area in the first uv set. Repair only reports them: they need a new unwrap. |
| `flippedNormals` |  | bool | `True` | Faces wound against the rest of their shell, or closed shells facing inward (repair turns them). |
| `tolerance` |  | float | `-1.0` | Distance under which points coincide and edges and faces count as zero size, cm; negative scales with the mesh. |
| `removeLoose` |  | bool | `True` | Repair also removes points and edges left without faces. |

### mirrorJoints

Mirror a joint hierarchy across a plane through the world origin. behavior=True mirrors the axes so equal rotations make mirrored poses; False keeps world orientation. Names swap searchReplace; side labels swap left/right. Returns the new joints.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `axis` | `ax` | str | `'x'` | Mirror across this axis: x mirrors across the YZ plane. |

| `searchReplace` | `sr` | list | `['_l', '_r']` | [search, replace] for the new names. |

### mirrorMorphTarget

Mirror a target through the base's symmetry (points matched across the axis plane in object space). mode flip makes a new target with the shape on the other side, named with left and right swapped; symmetrize copies one side onto the other in place. In-betweens go along. Returns the target written.

**Objects:** target

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `axis` |  | str | `'x'` | Mirror axis, object space. One of `x`, `y`, `z`. |
| `mode` |  | str | `'flip'` | flip \| symmetrize |
| `direction` |  | int | `1` | symmetrize: 1 copies the positive side onto the negative, -1 the reverse. |
| `tolerance` |  | float | `0.001` | How far a point may be from its partner's reflection, cm. |
| `name` |  | str |  | flip: the new target's name. |

With a pose name, store its mirror image as a new pose (newName, default <name>_mirror). Without one, mirror the selected character's current pose onto itself: left and right swap, centre nodes reflect.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `nodes` | `n` | list |  | Nodes picking the character instead of the selection. |
| `mirrorAxis` | `ma` | str | `'x'` | Axis the mirror plane faces. One of `x`, `y`, `z`. |

Mirror weights across a world plane through the origin: points on the source side copy to their mirror partners, with influences swapped by searchReplace (an influence with no partner maps to itself).

### moveComponents

Move the selected components by an offset in world space, or with normal= push each point along its own vertex normal (a face selection uses only the selected faces' normals, so the region inflates as a whole). uvn= also slides each point along its own surface tangents: U follows the uv0 u direction where the mesh has uvs (in edge mode, the selected edges), else the world axis least aligned with the selection's normal, and V completes the frame. Curve points use the curve's frame: U its tangent (a handle's own direction), N across it within its plane, V out of the plane.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `by` |  | tuple[float, float, float] |  | Offset, cm. |
| `normal` |  | float |  | Distance along the vertex normals, cm. |
| `uvn` |  | tuple[float, float, float] |  | Distances along each point's own U tangent, V tangent and normal, cm. |
| `onto` |  | list |  | Meshes whose surface each moved point then lands on, at its closest point. |

### polyBoolean

Union, difference or intersection of meshes (Manifold: robust, watertight output), with the seam cleaned up: slivers welded, the n-gons along the cut split into quads that carry on the edge loops, an optional rounded fillet, and weighted normals. The first object keeps the result; the others are deleted unless keepCutters=True.

**Objects:** base cutters...

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `operation` |  | str | `'difference'` | union, difference or intersection. |
| `keepCutters` |  | bool | `False` | Keep the cutter objects (hidden). |
| `live` |  | bool | `False` | Keep it live instead of baking: a boolean modifier per cutter, so moving or editing a cutter updates the cut. The cutters go in a template display layer (BooleanCutters): grey wire you select from the outliner. |
| `cleanup` |  | bool | `True` | Weld slivers and stray points along the seam. |
| `snapDistance` |  | float | `-1.0` | Weld distance for cleanup, cm; negative is a tenth of the median seam edge. |
| `splitNgons` |  | bool | `True` | Cut the n-gons along the seam into quads (and triangles) that carry on the edge loops. |
| `quadBand` |  | bool | `False` | Remesh a band of faces around the seam into quads that follow it, welded back into the faces around it. Falls back to splitting n-gons where the band's border can't be kept. |
| `bandRings` |  | int | `1` | Rings of faces past the seam the quad band takes in. |
| `timeout` |  | float | `5.0` | Seconds the quad band remesh may take before the n-gon split runs instead; 0 waits forever. |
| `filletWidth` |  | float | `0.0` | Width of a rounded strip along the seam, cm; 0 keeps it sharp. |
| `filletSegments` |  | int | `2` | Rows of faces across the fillet. |
| `hardAngle` |  | float | `30.0` | New edges sharper than this many degrees are marked hard. |
| `weightedNormals` |  | bool | `True` | Add a weighted normals modifier, if the mesh has none, so the n-gons shade flat. |

Fit the selected edge loops, the border of each selected face region, or the selected vertices to a circle in their best-fit plane, turned to move the points least. ### polyConformToObject

Conform the selected components onto another mesh or a curve. loop: each selected edge loop (or face region border) lands one to one on the target's nearest closed loop (a cylinder's rim, a ring), at the turn that moves it least, or spread along it when the counts differ; face interiors follow. surface: every point to the nearest surface point. vertex: every point to the nearest target vertex. A curve target works through its line: loop spreads a loop along a closed curve, surface puts each point on the nearest point of the curve.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target` |  | str |  | Mesh or curve to conform to; default: the selected mesh or curve that has no components selected. |
| `mode` |  | str | `'loop'` | loop, surface or vertex. |
| `spacing` |  | str | `'even'` | Loop mode with unequal counts: even, keep or project. |
| `strength` |  | float | `1.0` | How far toward the shape, 0 to 1; soft selection fades it further. |

### polyKnife

Knife / multi-cut: cut a mesh along a path of points, splitting the faces between them and the edges the path crosses. Between two points the cut follows the surface under the straight screen line joining them (seen from eye= or along direction=; without either, along the points' average normal). With loopEdge= it inserts an edge loop across that edge's quad ring instead. Follows the mesh's symmetry. Returns the new edges.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mesh` |  | str |  | Mesh to cut; default: the selected or hilited mesh. |
| `points` |  | list |  | Path points: {"vertex": id}, {"edge": id, "t": 0..1 from its first point}, or {"face": id, "position": [x, y, z] world}. |
| `closed` |  | bool | `False` | Also cut from the last point back to the first. |
| `through` |  | bool | `False` | Cut every face under the line, hidden faces too. |
| `eye` |  | tuple[float, float, float] |  | World eye of a perspective view. |
| `direction` |  | tuple[float, float, float] |  | World view direction of an orthographic view. |
| `loopEdge` |  | int | `-1` | Insert an edge loop across this edge's ring instead of cutting a path. |
| `fraction` |  | float | `0.5` | Where along loopEdge the loop crosses it, from its first point. |
| `select` |  | bool | `True` | Select the new edges. |

### polyMirror

Mirror whole meshes across the plane through the object's or the world's origin facing an axis, welding along the seam. direction positive keeps the + side and rebuilds the - side from it, cutting faces that cross the plane; negative does the reverse; both adds a mirrored copy of the whole mesh. flip=True reflects the mesh across the plane instead, keeping nothing of the original.

| `direction` |  | str | `'positive'` | positive (+ to -), negative (- to +) or both. |
| `space` |  | str | `'object'` | object or world: whose origin and axes the plane uses. |
| `weld` |  | bool | `True` | Weld points on the plane. |
| `tolerance` |  | float | `0.001` | Points this close to the plane are cut onto it and welded, cm. |
| `flip` |  | bool | `False` | Reflect the mesh across the plane rather than adding a mirrored copy: the original is not kept. |

### polyTriangulate

Triangulate the selected faces (the whole mesh in object mode), deterministically, as Unreal will. Concave and non-planar faces, collinear points and faces touching themselves split without overlaps or slivers, and no diagonal doubles an edge another face already has. With symmetry on, the mirrored faces split the mirrored way. A whole mesh with modifiers gets a triangulate modifier on top instead, so the result is triangulated rather than the cage.

### quadRemesh

Auto quad remesh: a new all-quad mesh whose edge flow follows curvature, hard edges and guide curves, at about the target face count, with UVs (and optionally normals) transferred from the source. Open borders, sharp creases, crease corners and cone tips are kept. Where the shape is too thin or tight for the requested size (a strip narrower than the edge length) it retries finer, so the face count can come out higher. The kept source is hidden. Runs off the UI thread with a cancellable progress bar, and gives up after timeout= seconds with an error saying how far it got, changing nothing. Returns {name, metrics}.

**Objects:** source

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `targetFaces` |  | int | `500` | Approximate face count. |
| `timeout` |  | float | `5.0` | Seconds before giving up with an error saying how far it got, leaving the scene as it was; 0 waits forever. |
| `targetEdgeLength` |  | float | `0.0` | Edge length, cm; overrides targetFaces when positive. |
| `adaptivity` |  | float | `0.25` | 0 uniform, 1 much denser where curved; painted point 'density' multiplies. |
| `useHardEdges` |  | bool | `True` | Follow edges marked hard. |
| `sharpAngle` |  | float | `40.0` | Also follow creases sharper than this, degrees; negative disables. |
| `symmetry` |  | str | `'off'` | off, x, y or z: remesh half and mirror, exactly symmetric. |
| `guides` |  | list |  | Mesh nodes whose edges are guide curves. |
| `guidePoints` |  | list |  | Guide polylines as lists of world [x, y, z]. |
| `pureQuads` |  | bool | `True` | All quads; false allows a few triangles and pentagons. |
| `resolveGaps` |  | bool | `True` | Finer where the surface comes close to itself across a gap (a ball in a pocket), so the gap isn't bridged; costs faces. |
| `seamless` |  | bool | `False` | Experimental: also try a global layout that only turns at the poles, kept when it has fewer irregular points. |
| `poles` |  | list |  | The poles the edge flow turns at, as {position: world [x, y, z], valence: 3 or 5}, and nowhere else. Start from retopoPoles; on a closed shell (4 - valence) must sum to what retopoPoles reports. |
| `relaxIterations` |  | int | `6` | Tangential relax passes on the surface. |
| `transferUvs` |  | bool | `True` | Copy UV sets from the source. |
| `transferNormals` |  | bool | `False` | Copy the source's normals as custom normals. |
| `keepSource` |  | bool | `True` | Keep the source mesh; false deletes it. |
| `hideSource` |  | bool | `True` | Hide the kept source mesh. |
| `name` |  | str |  | Name of the new mesh. |

### relaxMesh

Even out point spacing while keeping the form: points slide over the mesh's own starting surface (or a target mesh), points on sharp creases and hard edges slide only along them, and crease corners and cone tips stay. No face is allowed to fold over. Moves only the selected components when there is a component selection. Honours the mesh's symmetry.

**Objects:** objects

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `iterations` |  | int | `10` | Smoothing passes, 1 to 1000. |
| `strength` |  | float | `0.5` | Step toward the neighbour average per pass, 0 to 1. |
| `target` |  | str |  | Mesh to stay on; default is the mesh itself. |
| `project` |  | bool | `True` | Keep points on the surface. Off is plain smoothing, which shrinks and rounds the shape. |
| `pinBoundary` |  | bool | `True` | Keep border points fixed; off lets them slide along the border, keeping its outline. |
| `sharpAngle` |  | float | `12.0` | Edges whose faces meet sharper than this are creases that keep their line, degrees; negative turns it off. |
| `keepHardEdges` |  | bool | `True` | Hard edges keep their line like creases do. |
| `pinCreases` |  | bool | `False` | Keep points on creased edges fixed. |
| `pinHard` |  | bool | `False` | Keep points on hard edges fixed. |
| `pinSeams` |  | bool | `False` | Keep points on UV seams fixed. |

### retopoPoles

The poles quadRemesh's edge flow would turn at with these options, without remeshing: where each one is and its valence (3 or 5). Move, add or remove them and pass them back as quadRemesh(poles=...). Also returns, per closed shell, what (4 - valence) over its poles has to sum to.

| `targetEdgeLength` |  | float | `0.0` | Edge length, cm; overrides targetFaces when positive. |
| `adaptivity` |  | float | `0.25` | 0 uniform, 1 much denser where curved; painted point 'density' multiplies. |

| `sharpAngle` |  | float | `40.0` | Also follow creases sharper than this, degrees; negative disables. |
| `symmetry` |  | str | `'off'` | off, x, y or z: remesh half and mirror, exactly symmetric. |

| `guidePoints` |  | list |  | Guide polylines as lists of world [x, y, z]. |
| `pureQuads` |  | bool | `True` | All quads; false allows a few triangles and pentagons. |
| `resolveGaps` |  | bool | `True` | Finer where the surface comes close to itself across a gap (a ball in a pocket), so the gap isn't bridged; costs faces. |
| `seamless` |  | bool | `False` | Experimental: also try a global layout that only turns at the poles, kept when it has fewer irregular points. |
| `poles` |  | list |  | The poles the edge flow turns at, as {position: world [x, y, z], valence: 3 or 5}, and nowhere else. Start from retopoPoles; on a closed shell (4 - valence) must sum to what retopoPoles reports. |

### sculptCorrective

Start a corrective: pose the rig, then this copies the mesh as it looks now into <mesh>_corrective, in place, and hides the mesh. Sculpt the fix on the copy, then run addCorrective. Returns the sculpt mesh.

### sculptEnter

Enter sculpt mode on a mesh: builds a temporary high-resolution proxy of its cage to sculpt on. mode='subdivide' (Catmull-Clark, levels deep) reprojects exactly on exit; 'remesh' sculpts a uniform voxel remesh; 'direct' sculpts the mesh itself. Resumes from a kept proxy when there is one. Returns {mesh, mode, levels, points, faces}.

**Objects:** mesh

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |

| `resolution` |  | int | `192` | Voxels along the longest side, for mode='remesh'. |
| `resume` |  | bool | `True` | Continue from the mesh's kept proxy when it has one. |

### sculptExit

Leave sculpt mode, moving the low-poly cage onto the sculpt. method='fit' solves for the cage whose subdivision best matches the sculpt (least squares through the subdivision stencils); 'closest' and 'normal' project each cage point onto the sculpted surface instead. Only positions change: UVs and other attributes stay. keepProxy stores the proxy as a hidden child mesh to resume from. Returns {mesh, maxMove}.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `method` |  | str | `'fit'` | fit, closest or normal. |

| `iterations` |  | int | `3` | Project-and-fit rounds for remeshed proxies. |

### setBakeOutput

Set where and how a bake project writes: folder, file name template (tokens {project} {group} {mesh} {material} {map} {udim} {res} {ext}; several groups share a texture when their names resolve to the same file), format, bit depth, resolution, supersampling and padding. Returns the output settings.

| `bits` | `b` | int |  | 8 or 16 (PNG, PSD); 8, 16 or 32 float (TIFF); 16 half or 32 float (EXR). |

| `sidecar` | `sc` | bool |  | Write <texture>.json beside each texture (map, colour space, decode data). |
| `resolution` | `res` | int |  | Width and height. |
| `width` | `w` | int |  | Width in texels. |
| `height` | `h` | int |  | Height in texels. |
| `supersampling` | `ss` | int |  | Samples per texel: 1, 4, 16 or 64. |
| `padding` | `pad` | int |  | Texels of dilation past island borders; -1 fills the texture. |

| `name` | `n` | str |  | Name for the skinCluster. |

### switchSpace

Switch nodes to another space keeping their world pose: keys the space channel (stepped) and re-keys translate, rotate and scale in the new frame at the time, on the active layer. With range, every key in it (every frame with bake) keeps its pose, and the frames either side keep theirs. An unanimated node just changes. Returns the space index.

**Objects:** nodes

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `space` | `sp` | Any |  | 'parent', 'world', a target's name, or the index. |
| `time` | `t` | float |  | Seconds. Default: the current time. |
| `range` | `r` | list |  | (start, end) seconds to switch over. |
| `bake` | `b` | bool | `False` | With range: key every frame, so even the motion between keys is unchanged. |
| `preserve` | `pr` | str | `'world'` | world: keep the world pose; none: only change the space. |
| `key` | `k` | bool |  | Key rather than set. Default: when the node is animated. |
| `hold` | `h` | bool | `True` | Key the old space and pose a frame before (and after a range) so the rest of the animation keeps its pose. |

### symmetrize

Make meshes exactly symmetric: every point on one side of the symmetry plane is copied, reflected, onto its partner, and on-plane points are put on the plane.

**Objects:** objects

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `side` |  | str | `'positive'` | The side that is kept. One of `positive`, `negative`. |

### symmetryCheck

Report how symmetric meshes are across their symmetry plane: the largest distance between a point and its partner's reflection, and the points without a partner. Changes nothing.

**Objects:** objects

### symmetryRebuild

Rebuild meshes symmetric: the kept side is mirrored across the plane through the object's pivot, replacing the other side, welded on the plane, and the symmetry pairs are stored again. With pairsOnly, the geometry is left alone and only the stored pairs are matched again, by position or, for meshes that are no longer symmetric, by topology outward from the selected edge (which must lie on the plane). Returns the points left unmatched per mesh.

**Objects:** objects

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `axis` |  | str |  | x, y or z; default: the mesh's symmetry axis, else x. |
| `side` |  | str | `'auto'` | The side that is kept; auto: the side of the selected components, else the side holding nearly all of the mesh, else positive. One of `auto`, `positive`, `negative`. |
| `pairsOnly` |  | bool | `False` | Only match the stored pairs again, leaving the geometry as it is. |
| `topological` |  | bool | `False` | With pairsOnly: match by topology from the selected edge. |
| `tolerance` |  | float | `0.0` | Weld or match distance, cm (0: scaled to the mesh). |

### texPaintStroke

Paint a stroke into a texture set's paint layer (layer=, else the active one, else the stack's top paint layer, else a new paint layer). The stroke is a record: {mesh, brush (radius, strength, flow, spacing, falloff, roundness, angle, alpha, strokeMode line, lazyRadius, mirror...), payload {kind, channels {baseColor: [r, g, b], roughness: 0.3, ...}, blend normal|erase|add|subtract|multiply, mask}, occlusion, particles}, plus either space=surface with dabs [{triangle, bary [u, v], radius, pressure, opacity, angle}] or [{position [x, y, z], radius}] (object space), or space=screen with points [[x, y, pressure]] and view {width, height, camera | view + proj | viewProj + eye | eye + lookAt + fov}. Payload kinds: paint; direction (tilt, channel: normal, or another channel for a flow map); smudge (amount), blur and sharpen (filterRadius texels, amount), clone and heal (sourceOffset [du, dv] or cloneFrom [x, y, z]); fill (fillBy mesh|island|material|selection with at [x, y, z], triangle, material or faces; no dabs); project (image: a file path, {path, rect [x, y, w, h], opacity}, or {width, height, data}, through view; facingFade, colorChannel; no dabs); normal (normalMode bump|stamp, stampImage, intensity, channel). paint and fill take source {library id | graph | node type, values, resolution, scale} to paint a material's channels, and any kind tip {node | graph, values, resolution} for a texture graph brush tip. particles {kind drips|rain|sparks, count, length, size, spread, rate, seed} adds particle dabs. Each stroke is one undo step and is kept, so texRasterize can replay it. Returns {layer, stroke, dabs, pages}.

**Objects:** set [layer]

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stroke` |  | Any |  | The stroke record (an object, or its JSON text). |
| `layer` |  | str |  | The paint layer (its id). |
| `mesh` |  | str |  | The painted mesh; default the first using the set's material. |
| `payload` |  | Any |  | What the stroke writes, when stroke has none. |
| `brush` |  | Any |  | Brush settings, when stroke has none. |
| `points` |  | list |  | Screen points [[x, y, pressure]], when stroke has none. |
| `view` |  | Any |  | Screen view, when stroke has none. |
| `space` |  | str |  | surface or screen (default: screen when there are points). |
| `particles` |  | Any |  | Particle brush {kind, count, length, size, spread, rate, seed}, when stroke has none. |
| `id` |  | int |  | The stroke id the paint tool painted live under. |

### textureFolders

Which project images the material editor's texture lists show. Globs relative to the project folder (the workspace root, else the scene's folder): `*` within a folder name, `**` across folders, a pattern without '/' matches at any depth, and a folder pattern takes everything under it, e.g. Textures/**, **/*_old.*, Saved. Empty include takes everything; exclude wins. Kept in the workspace's .lila/settings.json, or with scene=True in the scene, where each list overrides the workspace's. With no flags returns the effective lists, where each came from and both levels.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `include` | `i` | list |  | Include globs; [] clears them. |
| `exclude` | `e` | list |  | Exclude globs; [] clears them. |
| `scene` | `s` | bool | `False` | Set the scene's override instead of the workspace's lists. |
| `clear` | `c` | bool | `False` | Remove the lists at that level (with scene, the scene falls back to the workspace). |

### unrealSendTextureSet

Send a texture set to Unreal: exports it through the Unreal preset (only tiles and channels that changed since the last export are rewritten and sent, unless all=True) and updates the textures and the material instance of the set's slot (MI_<slot>), set on the slot of every mapped mesh using it. Painterly and Toon materials become instances of LilaLink's stylised masters with their palette values; others need materialParent (or the unreal pref), else only textures go. The set then also goes on every save. Returns {queued, textures} or, with wait=True, Unreal's {assets, warnings, errors}.

### uvAuto

Automatic uvs: seams, low-stretch unwrap and pack, in one step.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `uvSet` |  | str |  | UV set; the current one (uvSetCurrent) when not given. |
| `iterations` |  | int | `12` | SLIM iterations. |
| `hardAngle` |  | float | `60.0` | Edges sharper than this always get a seam, degrees. |
| `useHardEdges` |  | bool | `True` | Edges marked hard always get a seam. |
| `keepSeams` |  | bool | `False` | Keep the seams already there. |
| `maxDistortion` |  | float | `0.08` | Split islands that stretch more than this when flattened. |
| `visibility` |  | bool | `True` | Hide cuts where they are least visible. |
| `merge` |  | bool | `True` | Merge islands back while they still flatten well. |
| `method` |  | str | `'split'` | split (hard edges, open to disks, split where stretched) or optcuts (Auto Seams 2: seams and distortion optimised together). |
| `distortionBound` |  | float | `0.05` | optcuts: stretch (symmetric Dirichlet excess, all islands) to get under. |
| `seamWeight` |  | float | `0.5` | optcuts: price of seam length against stretch; higher keeps seams shorter. |
| `resolution` |  | int | `1024` | Target texture size, px. Padding and margin are in its texels. |
| `padding` |  | float | `4.0` | Texels between islands, held exactly (the search never lets two islands closer). |
| `margin` |  | float | `-1.0` | Texels from the tile (or region) border; negative is half the padding. |
| `paddingMips` |  | int | `0` | Padding and margin survive this many mip levels: both are multiplied by 2^paddingMips. |
| `rotateStep` |  | int | `90` | Rotation step to try, degrees: 0 none, 90 quarter turns, smaller for more. |
| `angles` |  | list |  | Exact angles to try, degrees (replaces rotateStep), e.g. [0, 90, 45]. |
| `freeRotation` |  | bool | `False` | Any angle: each island also tries its three best-fitting angles (smallest bounding box) and their quarter turns. |
| `flip` |  | bool | `False` | Also try islands mirrored (the texture then reads mirrored on them). |
| `orient` |  | bool | `True` | Turn islands to their smallest bounding rectangle first. |
| `scaleMode` |  | str | `'normalize'` | normalize: even texel density across islands and objects (world space). keep: islands keep their relative uv sizes. lock: islands keep their exact uv size and are only moved and turned. |
| `normalize` |  | bool | `True` | Same as scaleMode=normalize when on, keep when off. |
| `stack` |  | bool | `False` | Islands with the same shape (within stackTolerance) share one spot. |
| `stackMirrored` |  | bool | `True` | Mirror-image islands stack too (the mirrored halves of a symmetric model). |
| `stackTolerance` |  | float | `0.002` | Largest vertex mismatch for two islands to stack, as a fraction of the island's size. |
| `tilesU` |  | int | `1` | UDIM tiles across. |
| `tilesV` |  | int | `1` | UDIM tiles up. |
| `region` |  | list |  | Pack into [uMin, vMin, uMax, vMax] of each tile instead of all of it. |
| `texelsPerUnit` |  | float | `0.0` | Pack at this density (px/cm) instead of filling the tiles; overflow spills into further tiles. |
| `effort` |  | int | `1` | Search effort 0-3: island orders tried per scale (1, 3, 6, 12). Higher packs denser, slower. |
| `timeLimit` |  | float | `0.0` | Stop refining after this many seconds (0 never); results can then vary between runs. |
| `workingResolution` |  | int | `0` | Search raster cells across a tile; 0 uses the resolution up to 4096. |

### uvAutoSeams

Place seams for game assets on the selected faces: hard edges, then cuts that open each island along hidden, creased paths and split it where it would stretch.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hardAngle` |  | float | `60.0` | Edges sharper than this always get a seam, degrees. |
| `useHardEdges` |  | bool | `True` | Edges marked hard always get a seam. |
| `keepSeams` |  | bool | `False` | Keep the seams already there. |
| `maxDistortion` |  | float | `0.08` | Split islands that stretch more than this when flattened. |
| `visibility` |  | bool | `True` | Hide cuts where they are least visible. |
| `merge` |  | bool | `True` | Merge islands back while they still flatten well. |
| `method` |  | str | `'split'` | split (hard edges, open to disks, split where stretched) or optcuts (Auto Seams 2: seams and distortion optimised together). |
| `distortionBound` |  | float | `0.05` | optcuts: stretch (symmetric Dirichlet excess, all islands) to get under. |
| `seamWeight` |  | float | `0.5` | optcuts: price of seam length against stretch; higher keeps seams shorter. |

### uvBff

Boundary First Flattening of the selected faces' islands: conformal, with the boundary chosen first. free keeps the boundary lengths (least area distortion), disk makes a circle, rectangle straight sides between four corners (the selected vertices, else the sharpest), polygon one straight side per selected corner. cones adds automatic cone points that cut the island open to cut area distortion. Islands keep their place unless pack=True or they had no uvs.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `uvSet` |  | str |  | UV set; the current one (uvSetCurrent) when not given. |
| `boundary` |  | str | `'free'` | free, disk, rectangle or polygon. |
| `cones` |  | int | `0` | Cone points placed automatically (free boundary only); each adds a short seam. |
| `exactLengths` |  | bool | `False` | free boundary: bend rather than stretch to close it, so its lengths are exact. |
| `pack` |  | bool | `False` | Pack the islands into 0-1 afterwards. |

### uvPack

Pack the uv islands of the selected faces (or whole meshes) into 0-1 with padding for a texture size. Every selected mesh goes into one shared layout, or each into its own with perObject. Islands are packed by their real shapes, into the holes of other islands, with rotations, optional mirroring and stacking of identical islands; the densest of several island orders wins. Returns the density reached (percent of the used tiles covered) and the texel density. Runs on worker threads and can be cancelled from the progress bar.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `uvSet` |  | str |  | UV set; the current one (uvSetCurrent) when not given. |
| `resolution` |  | int | `1024` | Target texture size, px. Padding and margin are in its texels. |
| `padding` |  | float | `4.0` | Texels between islands, held exactly (the search never lets two islands closer). |
| `margin` |  | float | `-1.0` | Texels from the tile (or region) border; negative is half the padding. |
| `paddingMips` |  | int | `0` | Padding and margin survive this many mip levels: both are multiplied by 2^paddingMips. |
| `rotateStep` |  | int | `90` | Rotation step to try, degrees: 0 none, 90 quarter turns, smaller for more. |
| `angles` |  | list |  | Exact angles to try, degrees (replaces rotateStep), e.g. [0, 90, 45]. |
| `freeRotation` |  | bool | `False` | Any angle: each island also tries its three best-fitting angles (smallest bounding box) and their quarter turns. |
| `flip` |  | bool | `False` | Also try islands mirrored (the texture then reads mirrored on them). |
| `orient` |  | bool | `True` | Turn islands to their smallest bounding rectangle first. |
| `scaleMode` |  | str | `'normalize'` | normalize: even texel density across islands and objects (world space). keep: islands keep their relative uv sizes. lock: islands keep their exact uv size and are only moved and turned. |
| `normalize` |  | bool | `True` | Same as scaleMode=normalize when on, keep when off. |
| `stack` |  | bool | `False` | Islands with the same shape (within stackTolerance) share one spot. |
| `stackMirrored` |  | bool | `True` | Mirror-image islands stack too (the mirrored halves of a symmetric model). |
| `stackTolerance` |  | float | `0.002` | Largest vertex mismatch for two islands to stack, as a fraction of the island's size. |
| `tilesU` |  | int | `1` | UDIM tiles across. |
| `tilesV` |  | int | `1` | UDIM tiles up. |
| `region` |  | list |  | Pack into [uMin, vMin, uMax, vMax] of each tile instead of all of it. |
| `texelsPerUnit` |  | float | `0.0` | Pack at this density (px/cm) instead of filling the tiles; overflow spills into further tiles. |
| `effort` |  | int | `1` | Search effort 0-3: island orders tried per scale (1, 3, 6, 12). Higher packs denser, slower. |
| `timeLimit` |  | float | `0.0` | Stop refining after this many seconds (0 never); results can then vary between runs. |
| `workingResolution` |  | int | `0` | Search raster cells across a tile; 0 uses the resolution up to 4096. |
| `layout` |  | str | `'fill'` | fill: fill the UDIM tiles in order. groupTiles: one tile per group. groupRegions: one part of tile 1001 per group, sized by its area. keepTile: islands stay in the tile they are in. |
| `groupBy` |  | str | `'none'` | What makes a group: object, material slot, or the face int attribute groupAttr. One of `none`, `object`, `material`, `attribute`. |
| `groupAttr` |  | str | `'uvGroup'` | Face int attribute holding each face's group, for groupBy=attribute. |
| `keep` |  | str | `'none'` | selected: the selected islands stay where they are and the rest pack around them. unselected: only the selection packs, around the rest. One of `none`, `selected`, `unselected`. |
| `fixPinned` |  | bool | `False` | Islands with pinned uvs stay where they are. |
| `perObject` |  | bool | `False` | Pack each selected mesh into a layout of its own instead of one shared layout. |

### uvPin

Pin the uvs of the selected components so the live solver, unwrap and relax keep them in place.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `uvSet` |  | str |  | UV set; the current one (uvSetCurrent) when not given. |

### uvProject

Project uvs onto the selected faces: planar, box, cylindrical, spherical or camera (matrix=object to clip, 16 numbers). The frame is fitted to the faces unless given; returns the frame used.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `uvSet` |  | str |  | UV set; the current one (uvSetCurrent) when not given. |
| `type` |  | str | `'planar'` | planar, box, cylindrical, spherical or camera. |
| `axis` |  | str | `'best'` | x, y, z or best (fitted to the faces). |
| `fit` |  | str | `'auto'` | Frame orientation when not given: auto (principal axes and normals), world or object axes. |
| `center` |  | tuple[float, float, float] |  | Frame centre, object space. |
| `rotation` |  | tuple[float, float, float] |  | Frame orientation, XYZ euler degrees in object space; Z is the projection axis. |
| `width` |  | float | `0.0` | Planar and box size along the frame's X; 0 fits the faces. |
| `height` |  | float | `0.0` | Planar and box size along Y, cylinder length along its axis; 0 fits the faces. |
| `depth` |  | float | `0.0` | Box size along Z; 0 fits the faces. |
| `radius` |  | float | `0.0` | Cylinder and sphere radius; 0 fits the faces. |
| `seamAngle` |  | float |  | Degrees about the axis where U wraps; unset places it where it cuts fewest faces, away from the camera. |
| `scaleU` |  | float | `1.0` | U scale, applied after the projection. |
| `scaleV` |  | float | `1.0` | V scale, applied after the projection. |
| `offsetU` |  | float | `0.0` | U offset, applied after the scale. |
| `offsetV` |  | float | `0.0` | V offset, applied after the scale. |
| `viewDir` |  | tuple[float, float, float] |  | World direction the camera looks along, for the seam; the UI passes the active view's. |
| `normalize` |  | bool | `True` | Fit into 0-1 keeping proportions. |
| `matrix` |  | list |  | Camera projection, column major, for type=camera. |
| `pack` |  | bool | `False` | Pack the resulting islands afterwards. |

### uvSetCurrent

The uv set the uv tools and editor work on. With no argument, returns it.

**Objects:** [uvSet]

Not undoable.

### uvSew

Sew the uvs along the selected edges (or edges= on the named mesh): unmarks the seams and welds the two sides. With move (move and sew) the smaller island first travels to meet the other; then the joined island relaxes.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `uvSet` |  | str |  | UV set; the current one (uvSetCurrent) when not given. |
| `edges` |  | list |  | Edge ids to sew instead of the selection (with the mesh named). |
| `move` |  | bool | `True` | Move the smaller island onto the other before welding. |
| `relax` |  | bool | `True` | Relax the joined island afterwards. |
| `iterations` |  | int | `40` | Relax iterations. |
| `balance` |  | float | `0.0` | Stretch against compression for the relax, -1..1. |

### uvSewEdges

Unmark the selected seams and weld their uvs, moving the smaller island over to meet the other.

Not undoable.

### uvUnwrap

Unwrap the selected faces' islands along their seams (LSCM, refined with SLIM for low stretch). Closed or holed islands are cut open first. Islands keep their place unless pack=True or they had no uvs.

| `padding` |  | float | `4.0` | Texels between islands, held exactly (the search never lets two islands closer). |
| `margin` |  | float | `-1.0` | Texels from the tile (or region) border; negative is half the padding. |
| `paddingMips` |  | int | `0` | Padding and margin survive this many mip levels: both are multiplied by 2^paddingMips. |
| `rotateStep` |  | int | `90` | Rotation step to try, degrees: 0 none, 90 quarter turns, smaller for more. |
| `angles` |  | list |  | Exact angles to try, degrees (replaces rotateStep), e.g. [0, 90, 45]. |
| `freeRotation` |  | bool | `False` | Any angle: each island also tries its three best-fitting angles (smallest bounding box) and their quarter turns. |
| `flip` |  | bool | `False` | Also try islands mirrored (the texture then reads mirrored on them). |
| `orient` |  | bool | `True` | Turn islands to their smallest bounding rectangle first. |
| `scaleMode` |  | str | `'normalize'` | normalize: even texel density across islands and objects (world space). keep: islands keep their relative uv sizes. lock: islands keep their exact uv size and are only moved and turned. |
| `normalize` |  | bool | `True` | Same as scaleMode=normalize when on, keep when off. |
| `stack` |  | bool | `False` | Islands with the same shape (within stackTolerance) share one spot. |
| `stackMirrored` |  | bool | `True` | Mirror-image islands stack too (the mirrored halves of a symmetric model). |
| `stackTolerance` |  | float | `0.002` | Largest vertex mismatch for two islands to stack, as a fraction of the island's size. |
| `tilesU` |  | int | `1` | UDIM tiles across. |
| `tilesV` |  | int | `1` | UDIM tiles up. |
| `region` |  | list |  | Pack into [uMin, vMin, uMax, vMax] of each tile instead of all of it. |

| `effort` |  | int | `1` | Search effort 0-3: island orders tried per scale (1, 3, 6, 12). Higher packs denser, slower. |

| `workingResolution` |  | int | `0` | Search raster cells across a tile; 0 uses the resolution up to 4096. |

### uvUnwrapSymmetric

Symmetry-aware unwrap of the selected faces using the mesh's symmetry pairs: islands on one side are solved and mirrored onto their partners (flip lays the mirror image beside, stack shares the same uvs), islands across the plane come out exactly mirror symmetric. Seams are mirrored first so islands pair up.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `uvSet` |  | str |  | UV set; the current one (uvSetCurrent) when not given. |
| `axis` |  | str | `'auto'` | x, y, z, or auto: the mesh's symmetry axis, else x. |
| `mode` |  | str | `'flip'` | flip or stack. |
| `method` |  | str | `'slim'` | slim, conformal or bff. |
| `mirrorSeams` |  | bool | `True` | Copy seams across the plane first. |
| `pack` |  | bool | `False` | Pack into 0-1 afterwards. |

### vertexColorStroke

One vertex paint stroke: dabs is a list of {center, radius, opacity, view, eye} in world space (center and radius required). Mirrors through the mesh's symmetry and stays inside the component selection. One undo step that stores only the changed corners. Returns {corners} changed.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |

| `colorSet` |  | str |  | Color set; empty uses the current one (made, white, when the mesh has none). |
| `blend` |  | str | `'replace'` | Blend mode. One of `replace`, `add`, `subtract`, `multiply`, `lighten`, `darken`, `blur`, `sharpen`. |
| `color` |  | list | `[1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0]` | Linear RGBA. |
| `strength` |  | float | `1.0` | Most the stroke changes a point, 0 to 1. |
| `channels` |  | str | `'rgba'` | Channels to change: some of r, g, b, a. |
| `falloff` |  | Any | `'Smooth'` | A soft select falloff preset name, "softSelect" for the current curve, or keys. |
| `frontFacesOnly` |  | bool | `True` | Leave points facing away from the view. |
| `paintThrough` |  | bool | `False` | Paint points hidden behind other parts too. |
| `mirror` |  | bool | `True` | Mirror across the mesh's symmetry when it is on. |
| `selectionOnly` |  | bool | `True` | With selected components, only they change. |
| `radialCount` |  | int | `1` | Copies of every dab turned evenly about an object axis; 1 is off. |
| `radialAxis` |  | str | `'y'` | The object axis radial copies turn about. One of `x`, `y`, `z`. |
| `dabs` |  | list |  | The stamps, in order. |
| `live` |  | int | `0` | Internal: adopts the stroke the viewport tool already applied. |

Rebuild meshes as one closed, manifold quad surface from a voxel grid, whatever state they are in: closes holes, fuses intersecting and inner shells. For dirty scans and kitbashed blockouts; UVs are not kept.

Make meshes follow a driver mesh (proximity wrap): each point binds to its nearest driver triangles. Give the meshes to deform first and the driver last. Returns the deformers.
