| `name` |  | str |  | Name for the deformer. |

### xform

Query or set the transform of objects, in local or world space.

Sets every flag given on each object, or with query=True returns one value of the first object: pass the flag to read as True. Values are local to the parent unless worldSpace is on.

**Objects:** Transforms to edit or query; the selection when none are given.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | `q` | bool | `False` | Return a value of the first object instead of setting. Pick it by passing one of translation, rotation, scale or matrix as True. Example: `xform("cube1", query=True, translation=True)` |
| `worldSpace` | `ws` | bool | `False` | Read and write in world space instead of relative to the parent. Rotation and scale queries stay local. Example: `xform("cube1", worldSpace=True, translation=(0, 2, 0))` |
| `translation` | `t` | Any |  | Position as (x, y, z) to set, or True to read it with query. Example: `xform("cube1", translation=(1, 0, 0))` |
| `rotation` | `ro` | Any |  | Euler rotation in degrees as (x, y, z) to set, or True to read it with query. Example: `xform("cube1", rotation=(0, 45, 0))` |
| `scale` | `s` | Any |  | Scale as (x, y, z) to set, or True to read it with query. Example: `xform("cube1", scale=(2, 2, 2))` |
| `matrix` | `m` | Any |  | The whole transform as 16 floats, column-major, to set; or True to read it with query. Example: `xform("cube1", query=True, worldSpace=True, matrix=True)` |

```python
xform("cube1", translation=(0, 1, 0), rotation=(0, 90, 0))
```

```python
pos = xform("cube1", query=True, worldSpace=True, translation=True)
```

## Overlap extension

Available when the Overlap extension is loaded.

### addOverlapJoint

Per-joint Overlap settings (a keyable pin, delay, stiffness and exaggeration scales) on the Overlap node whose chains hold each joint. Returns the settings nodes.

**Objects:** joints (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pin` | `p` | float |  | Pin weight: 1 holds the joint on its animation. |
| `delay` | `d` | float |  | Frames its rotation lags. |

### createOverlap

Add Overlap to joints: one chain from each joint down its first children (or to end), on the character's Overlap node, made when it has none. Returns the Overlap node.

**Objects:** chain root joints (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Name of a new Overlap node. Default: <root joint>_overlap. |
| `end` | `e` | str |  | Last joint of the chain (one root joint only). |
| `space` | `sp` | str |  | Simulation space of a new Overlap node. One of `world`, `characterRoot`, `parent`. |

### createOverlapCollider

Make an Overlap collider (sphere or capsule), parented to a node so it follows it. Returns its name.

**Objects:** parent (default the first selected node; none for world)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shape` | `sh` | str | `'sphere'` | sphere \| capsule |
| `radius` | `r` | float | `5.0` | Radius, cm. |
| `length` | `l` | float | `20.0` | Capsule length, cm. |
| `name` | `n` | str | `'overlapCollider1'` | Name. |

## PhysicsAnimation extension

Available when the PhysicsAnimation extension is loaded.

### assignPhysicsMarker

Make the joints rigid bodies: a physics marker on each, its shape fitted to the joint's dominant-influence region of the skinned mesh (a bone-sized shape without one), limits fitted from the animation range when the joint moves. Returns the markers.

**Objects:** joints or transforms (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `solver` | `s` | str |  | The physics solver. Default: the one the skeleton uses, else the scene's only one, else a new one. |
| `behaviour` | `b` | str | `'poseMatch'` | Behaviour. One of `kinematic`, `poseMatch`, `simulated`, `proxy`. |
| `shape` | `sh` | str | `'capsule'` | Shape. One of `capsule`, `box`, `sphere`, `convexHull`. |
| `fitShape` | `fs` | bool | `True` | Fit the shape to the skinned mesh. |
| `fitLimits` | `fl` | bool | `True` | Fit limits from the animation range where the joint moves. |
| `start` |  | int |  | First frame for fitting limits. Default: the playback start. |
| `end` |  | int |  | Last frame for fitting limits. Default: the playback end. |

### createPhysicsCollider

Make meshes environment colliders the ragdoll lands on and pushes against. Returns the collider nodes.

**Objects:** meshes (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `solver` | `s` | str |  | The physics solver. Default: the one the skeleton uses, else the scene's only one, else a new one. |

### createPhysicsField

A force field on the ragdoll: extra gravity, wind, seeded turbulence or air drag. Returns the field.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `solver` | `s` | str |  | The physics solver. Default: the one the skeleton uses, else the scene's only one, else a new one. |
| `kind` | `k` | str | `'wind'` | Kind. One of `gravity`, `wind`, `turbulence`, `drag`. |
| `magnitude` | `m` | float |  | Strength (see the field's magnitude). |
| `direction` | `d` | tuple[float, float, float] |  | Direction, world space. |
| `seed` |  | int |  | Turbulence seed. |

### createPhysicsPin

A soft pin pulling a marker's body toward a world-space target, placed at the joint. Animate it to steer the ragdoll. Returns the pin.

**Objects:** marker or joint (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stiffness` | `st` | float | `4.0` | Spring frequency, Hz. |
| `orient` | `o` | bool | `False` | Match rotation too. |

### createPhysicsSolver

A physics solver: the node a ragdoll's markers, pins, colliders and fields live under. Returns its name.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `n` | str | `'physics1'` | Name. |

### fitPhysicsMarker

Refit markers: the shape to the joint's dominant-influence region of the skinned mesh, and/or the swing cones and twist range to the motion over the animation range. Returns the markers.

**Objects:** markers or their joints (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shape` | `sh` | str |  | Change the shape kind too. One of `capsule`, `box`, `sphere`, `convexHull`. |
| `fitShape` | `fs` | bool | `True` | Refit the shape. |
| `limits` | `l` | bool | `True` | Refit the limits from the animation. |
| `margin` | `mg` | float | `10.0` | Degrees added around the motion. |
| `start` |  | int |  | First frame. Default: the playback start. |
| `end` |  | int |  | Last frame. Default: the playback end. |

### physicsApplyPose

Key joints to world matrices at the current time on the active layer (what Live mode's Apply runs). Returns the number of joints keyed.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pose` | `p` | Any |  | {joint: [16 numbers, column-major world matrix]}. |

### physicsMarkerInfo

A marker's joint, semantic label, behaviour, shape and parent body, as the solver reads it.

**Objects:** markers or joints (default the selection)

Not undoable.

### physicsMarkersFromTemplate

One-click ragdoll: a marker on every joint below the root that carries a semantic label (pelvis, spine_02, hand_l ...: from Rig Templates' naming, the joint's type label or its name), with that label's default shape, behaviour and limits, shapes fitted to the skinned mesh. Fingers, twist and IK joints are left out. Returns the markers.

**Objects:** a joint of the skeleton (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `solver` | `s` | str |  | The physics solver. Default: the one the skeleton uses, else the scene's only one, else a new one. |
| `fitLimits` | `fl` | bool | `False` | Fit limits from the animation range instead of the label defaults. |
| `start` |  | int |  | First frame for fitting limits. |
| `end` |  | int |  | Last frame for fitting limits. |

### physicsProxyDisplay

Show or hide the meshes skinned to a ragdoll's joints, leaving the marker bodies as a light stand-in to animate with. Returns the meshes changed.

**Objects:** solver, or its markers or joints (default the selection, else the scene's only solver)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hideMeshes` | `hm` | bool | `True` | Hide (true) or show (false) the skinned meshes. |

### recordPhysics

Bake the ragdoll onto the joints: onto a new additive layer (mute it to compare, delete it to revert), or replacing their keys over the range. Returns the layer, or the keyed joints when replacing.

**Objects:** solver, or its markers or joints (default the selection, else the scene's only solver)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `m` | str | `'additive'` | additive \| replace |
| `start` |  | int |  | First frame. Default: the loop or playback range. |
| `end` |  | int |  | Last frame. |
| `tolerance` | `tol` | float | `0.0` | Additive only: reduce keys while within this (cm); 0 keys every frame. |

### retargetPhysicsMarker

Point a marker at a different joint, keeping its settings (refit the shape with fit). Returns the marker.

**Objects:** marker (or its joint), then the new joint

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fit` | `f` | bool | `False` | Refit the shape to the new joint. |

### selectPhysicsMarkers

Select the physics markers of joints (or every marker of a solver). Returns them.

**Objects:** joints or solvers (default the selection)

### snapToSimulation

Key the joints to the simulated pose at a frame (default the current one), on the active layer. Returns the keyed joints.

**Objects:** solver, or its markers or joints (default the selection, else the scene's only solver)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `frame` | `f` | int |  | Frame. Default: the current one. |

## Puppeteer extension

Available when the Puppeteer extension is loaded.

### bankDuplicateTake

Copy a take as a new, inactive take named with the next free _NN suffix (Walk -> Walk_01). Returns its name.

**Objects:** take

### characterLabels

The semantic labels of a character's joints (pelvis, thigh_l ...), from its rig template or by name, as {joint: label}.

**Objects:** a node in the character (default the selection)

Not undoable.

### cycleSide

Cycle Side: give the opposite side of the selected joints their motion half a cycle later, mirrored. Key k of the n keys before the loop key takes the pose of key (k + n/2) mod n, so n must be even. Returns the channel keys set.

**Objects:** joints (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `axis` | `ax` | str | `'x'` | Axis the mirror plane faces. One of `x`, `y`, `z`. |

### cycleStep

Cycle Step: build the second step of a cycle from the first. The keys in the first half are mirrored (left and right swapped, centre reflected) half a cycle later, replacing any keys there. The cycle ends at the loop key, or end. Returns how many keys were made and replaced.

**Objects:** a node in the character (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `axis` | `ax` | str | `'x'` | Axis the mirror plane faces. One of `x`, `y`, `z`. |
| `end` | `e` | float |  | Cycle end frame when the character has no loop key. |

### exportTake

Write a take (its settings and curves) to a .lilatake JSON file. Layer blend chains are not written; merge layers first. Returns the file, the curves written and the channels skipped.

**Objects:** take

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `p` | str |  | File to write. |

Not undoable.

### importTake

Read a .lilatake file as a new take on its character (matched by node names without namespace). The take it was active for stays active unless activate. Returns the new take's name.

**Objects:** file

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Take name. Default: the file's. |
| `root` | `r` | str |  | Character root to put it on. Default: the file's. |
| `activate` | `a` | bool | `False` | Switch to the new take. |

### puppeteerBreakdown

Breakdown: key the pose at the current time part way toward the previous key (weight -1) or the next key (weight 1), for the selected joints or (all) every joint of their characters. Returns the channels keyed.

**Objects:** transforms (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `weight` | `w` | float | `0.0` | -1 previous key, 0 unchanged, 1 next key. |
| `all` | `a` | bool | `False` | Every joint of the selection's characters (of the scene with no character). |
| `time` | `t` | float |  | Seconds; default the current time. |

### puppeteerCharacter

Make a Puppeteer character for a skeleton: it finds the meshes skinned to it and the rig template it came from, and groups its rig elements, takes and poses. Returns its name.

**Objects:** root joint (default the selection's top joint)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Character name; defaults to the root's name plus _character. |
| `meshes` | `m` | list |  | Meshes, instead of those skinned to the skeleton. |
| `template` | `tp` | str |  | Rig template id, instead of the one the skeleton came from. |
| `poseLibrary` | `pl` | str |  | Pose library group instead of the template or root name. |

### puppeteerCharacterInfo

A character's root, meshes, template, pose library, rig elements, takes and poses.

**Objects:** character or a node in it

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `character` | `ch` | str |  | The character. |

Not undoable.

### puppeteerFootChannels

Roll, twist and bank reverse feet by degrees (or to them, with absolute), within each foot's limits (footChannels).

**Objects:** reverse feet, their chains or ankles (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `roll` | `r` | float |  | Roll: positive onto the toe (heel up), negative onto the heel. |
| `twist` | `tw` | float |  | Twist around the ball. |
| `bank` | `b` | float |  | Bank: positive onto the outer edge. |
| `absolute` | `abs` | bool | `False` | Set the values instead of adding to them. |

### puppeteerFootLock

Lock (plant) or unlock the key at a time on IK and reverse foot controllers (ikLock): a locked key holds the controller, and the foot or hand with it, until the chain's next key. Toggles without state. Returns each chain's new state.

**Objects:** IK controllers, reverse feet or joints in IK chains (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `time` | `t` | float |  | Seconds; default the current time. |
| `state` | `s` | bool |  | Locked or not; default the opposite of now. |

### puppeteerFootPivot

Move one of reverse feet's pivots (heel, ball, toe, inner or outer edge) to a world position on the sole (footPivot).

**Objects:** reverse feet, their chains or ankles (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pivot` | `pv` | str |  | Which pivot. One of `heel`, `ball`, `toe`, `inner`, `outer`. |
| `position` | `p` | tuple[float, float, float] |  | World position; its height is dropped onto the sole. |

### puppeteerIkChain

Make an IK chain (ikChain) from a start joint to an end effector, under the joint's character. Grabbing its controller poses the joints' rotations; there is no IK/FK switch. Returns the chain.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startJoint` | `sj` | str |  | First joint. |
| `endJoint` | `ej` | str |  | End effector. |
| `solver` | `sol` | str |  | IK solver; default ik2BoneSolver for three joints, else FABRIK. |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Chain name; default <effector>_ik. |
| `parent` | `p` | str |  | Node to put it under; default the joint's character. |

### puppeteerListCharacters

Every Puppeteer character with its root and pose library.

Not undoable.

### puppeteerLooker

Make a looker (looker) under the joint's character: the joint aims at it, blended by its keyable weight.

**Objects:** joint (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aimAxis` | `aa` | str | `'x'` | Joint axis that aims. |
| `upAxis` | `ua` | str | `'y'` | Joint axis leaned toward upVector. |
| `upVector` | `uv` | tuple[float, float, float] |  | World up; default +Y. |
| `distance` | `d` | float | `50.0` | How far in front of the joint the looker starts, cm. |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Name; default <joint>_looker. |

### puppeteerMigrateRig

Turn older Puppeteer IK chains, reverse feet and lookers into base rig elements. Chains that were in IK get their IK pose keyed as joint rotations at their keys, and the per-key IK/FK flag goes. Runs on its own when a scene opens. Returns how many elements were converted.

### puppeteerMigrateSpaces

Turn the scene's puppeteerSpace nodes (older Puppeteer scenes) into base spaces, keeping every key. Runs on its own when a scene opens. Returns how many were converted.

### puppeteerMirrorJoints

Mirror joints (and everything below them) to the other side, naming the copies by the side the joint's own name gives (arm_l to arm_r, LeftArm to RightArm, l_arm to r_arm). Returns the new roots.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `axis` | `ax` | str | `'x'` | Mirror across this axis: x mirrors across the YZ plane. One of `x`, `y`, `z`. |
| `behavior` | `b` | bool | `True` | Mirror behaviour instead of orientation. |

### puppeteerMove

Move transforms by a world offset. aim (sticky aim) turns each one's parent to point at the new position instead, keeping the bone's length. Returns the count.

**Objects:** transforms (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `by` |  | tuple[float, float, float] |  | World offset, cm. |

| `keepChildren` | `kc` | bool | `False` | Leave the children where they are (rigging a joint's pivot). |
| `stickyAim` | `sa` | bool | `False` | Rigging: re-aim the parent's and the joint's orients along the bones. |
| `sticky2nd` | `s2` | bool | `False` | With sticky aim: the secondary axis lies in the chain's plane. |
| `keepDirection` | `kd` | bool | `False` | With sticky 2nd: the secondary axis keeps pointing the way it did. |
| `fullBody` | `fb` | bool | `False` | Joints in a character move by posing the whole body: their pins and locked hands and feet hold. |

### puppeteerPin

Pin joints so full-body moves hold them where they are, or unpin them. With neither pin nor unpin given, toggles each. Returns the character's pinned joints.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pin` | `p` | bool |  | True pins, False unpins; leave out to toggle. |
| `clear` | `c` | bool | `False` | Unpin every joint of the joints' characters first. |

### puppeteerPole

Swing IK chains' pole by degrees (ikPole): the knee or elbow turns around the line from hip to foot. turn also turns the reverse foot or IK controller with it, so the foot follows the knee.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `turn` | `tu` | bool | `False` | Turn the controller with the pole. |

### puppeteerReverseFoot

Make a reverse foot (reverseFoot) on an IK chain's ankle, with Puppeteer's foot limits: a control on the sole that poses the leg and rolls the foot over heel, ball and toe, swivels on the ball and tips over its edges.

Turn transforms by angle degrees around a world axis. inherit keeps their children's world rotation, so only the selected joints turn. pivot center turns them around their common centre. Returns the count.

Multiply transforms' scale. compensate (toon scale) keeps their children's world size, so only the selected segment squashes or stretches. Returns the count.

Make a key after a key, holding that key's pose, one gap later (the gap before it by default); keys after it move later by the same gap. Returns the new key's index.

Delete keys with their timing: every later key moves earlier by the deleted key's gap. The loop key can't be deleted (turn the loop off first). Returns the keys.

Mirror the pose at keys: left and right swap, centre joints reflect across the mirror plane. Returns the channel keys set.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `run` | `r` | bool | `False` | A run: shorter contact, a flight phase, the bounce inverted. |
| `stride` | `sl` | float | `50.0` | cm each foot travels under the body while planted. |
| `speed` | `sp` | float | `0.0` | cm/s; above zero it sets the cycle length from the stride. |
| `cycleLength` | `cl` | float | `32.0` | Frames per cycle (two steps) when speed is zero. |
| `bounce` | `bo` | float | `3.0` | cm the pelvis rises and falls. |
| `stepHeight` | `sh` | float | `10.0` | cm the swinging foot lifts. |
| `armSwing` | `as` | float | `20.0` | Degrees each arm swings either way. |
| `lean` | `le` | float | `4.0` | Degrees the spine leans forward. |
| `sway` | `sw` | float | `2.0` | cm the pelvis shifts over the planted foot. |
| `twist` | `tw` | float | `6.0` | Degrees the pelvis turns with the legs. |
| `keysPerStep` | `kps` | int | `4` | Keys per step. |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Take name. Default: Walk or Run. |
| `restPose` | `rp` | str |  | Library pose to start from. Default: ref, else bind, else the current pose. |

## RigTemplates extension

Available when the RigTemplates extension is loaded.

### bindRigTemplate

Bind a template instance to meshes: its markers centre in them. Replaces any earlier binding.

**Objects:** instance, meshes...

### buildRigSkeleton

Build joints from a template instance's markers (or a template's defaults): template names, hierarchy and orientations from the template's rules, plus (rig) the template's IK chains, reverse feet, lookers, twist drivers and deform flags, so the skeleton is a working rig in one step. bindSkin binds the instance's meshes (or the given ones). Returns the root joint, the joints, any skinClusters and the rig elements.

**Objects:** instance or template id

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bindSkin` | `bs` | bool | `False` | Bind the meshes to the new skeleton. |
| `meshes` | `m` | list |  | Meshes to bind instead of the instance's. |
| `includeIk` | `ik` | bool | `True` | Build the template's ik helper joints too. |
| `prefix` | `p` | str |  | Prefix for the joint names. |
| `spaces` | `sp` | bool | `True` | Give the joints the template's default spaces (hands in world, chest, head ...). |
| `rig` | `rg` | bool | `True` | Build the template's rig elements too: IK chains, reverse feet, lookers, twist drivers and deform flags. |

### centerRigMarkers

Centre markers in the bound meshes' cross-sections across their limb, parents first. Takes an instance (every marker with centerInMesh on) or markers (each given one). Returns the markers moved.

**Objects:** instance or markers

### installRigTemplatePoses

Copy a template's poses into a pose library tier (scene, workspace or user) for its character, so they can be edited there; the template tier always has them. Returns the pose names.

**Objects:** template id

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tier` |  | str | `'scene'` | scene, workspace or user. |
| `character` | `c` | str |  | Library group; the template id by default. |

### listRigTemplates

The loaded rig templates: id, name, where each came from and what it holds.

Not undoable.

### loadRigTemplate

Load a .lilarig file into the template library (replacing a template with the same id). Returns its id.

**Objects:** path

Not undoable.

### mirrorRigMarkers

Copy one side's marker positions onto their mirror partners, reflected across the instance's centre plane (across the template's lateral axis). Returns the markers moved.

**Objects:** instance

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | `f` | str | `'left'` | The side copied: left or right. |

### orientRigSkeleton

Orient an existing skeleton's joints to a template's rules without moving them: joints are matched by name and alias. A skinned or animated skeleton changes through editSkeleton, so its meshes, animation and poses are kept. limbs limits it to some of the template's limbs. Without template, the best matching one is used. Returns the joints changed.

**Objects:** a joint of the skeleton

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `template` | `t` | str |  | Template id. |
| `limbs` | `l` | list |  | Limb names (spine, arm_l, leg_r, index_l ...); every limb when omitted. |
| `preserve` | `pr` | str |  | rest: the joints take the template's axes with rotate zeroed (skeletons with no skin or animation). worldPose: every pose keeps its world placement and rotate takes up the change, so the bind pose has the template's axes. channels: keys keep their values. Default: rest for a plain skeleton, worldPose otherwise. |

### placeRigTemplate

Place a template's markers in the scene under a new instance root, at the template's positions. With meshes, the instance is bound to them so its markers centre in them. Returns the root.

**Objects:** template id

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Name for the instance root. |
| `meshes` | `m` | list |  | Meshes to bind to. |

### rigTemplateInfo

A loaded template's full contents (the .lilarig JSON), or an instance's.

**Objects:** template id or instance

Not undoable.

### rigTemplatePicker

Make a Control Picker document from a template's picker layout and store it in the scene (undoable), named after the template unless name is given. Returns the document's name.

**Objects:** template id or instance

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Document name. |
| `namespace` | `ns` | str |  | Default namespace for its targets. |

### saveRigTemplate

Write a template to a .lilarig file. Without a path it goes to the user's template folder (or the workspace's with workspace=True). Returns the path.

**Objects:** template id or instance, [path]

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workspace` | `ws` | bool | `False` | Save into <workspace>/.lila/rigTemplates. |

Not undoable.

### templateFromSkeleton

Make a rig template from a skeleton: a marker per joint with its position, recorded orientation, semantic label, side and mirror partner, orientation rules that reproduce it, limb groups, a picker layout, bind/T/A poses and naming aliases. Helper joints (twist, corrective) and ik joints follow the main ones. Adds it to the library and, with file, saves it. Returns its summary.

**Objects:** a joint of the skeleton

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` |  | str |  | Template id; the top joint's name by default. |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Display name. |
| `description` | `d` | str |  | Description. |
| `file` | `f` | str |  | Save it here as .lilarig. |
| `includeIk` | `ik` | bool | `True` | Keep ik_ joints (flagged ik). |
| `free` |  | list |  | Joints to keep as placeable markers even if they look like helpers. |
| `source` |  | Any |  | Provenance to record in the template (an object). |

Not undoable.

### unbindRigTemplate

Unbind a template instance from its meshes; the markers stay where they are.

**Objects:** instance

The plane's material is named material for the export only. Returns {high, low, ids, colours}.

## TerrainTools extension

Available when the TerrainTools extension is loaded.

### addBladeDeformer

Add a nonlinear deformer to the selected faces (a whole mesh when no components are selected), one per blade or one for the whole selection, weighted so only the blades' own points move and their roots stay planted. Then randomizes the amount in low..high. Returns the deformers.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `k` | str | `'bend'` | bend \| flare \| twist \| sine \| squash \| wave |
| `perBlade` | `pb` | bool | `True` | A deformer per blade; off, one for the whole selection. |
| `fromBase` | `fb` | bool | `True` | Anchor the handle at each blade's root so it deforms root to tip; off centres it. |
| `spin` |  | bool | `True` | Spin each handle around the up axis, so blades lean different ways. |
| `up` |  | str | `'Auto'` | Up axis: Auto follows the scene. One of `Auto`, `X`, `Y`, `Z`. |
| `seed` | `s` | int | `0` | 0 differs every run; any other number repeats. |
| `low` |  | float |  | Lowest amount; the kind's default range when not given. |
| `high` |  | float |  | Highest amount. |
| `bias` | `b` | float | `0.0` | Bias to top, -1 to 1, over the amount range. |

### bladeDeformers

The nonlinear deformers of a kind on the selection or the named nodes (meshes, components, handles).

**Objects:** nodes (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `k` | str | `'bend'` | bend \| flare \| twist \| sine \| squash \| wave |

Not undoable.

### bladeExtrude

Extrude faces into blades that remember how they were built, so randomizeBladeExtrude can vary each one later. Faces default to the face selection (a whole selected mesh means every face). Returns {mesh: [blade ids]}.

**Objects:** mesh (with faces=)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `faces` | `f` | list |  | Face ids of the one mesh given. |
| `thickness` | `t` | float | `1.0` | How far the blades grow along their face normal, cm. |
| `offset` | `o` | float | `0.0` | How much the blades narrow as they grow: the cap border moves this far inward, cm. |
| `localTranslateZ` | `ltz` | float | `0.0` | Extra growth along the face normal, cm. |
| `divisions` | `d` | int | `1` | Segments up each blade. |
| `keepFacesTogether` | `kft` | bool | `False` | Connected faces grow as one blade; off, every face is its own. |

### bladeExtrudeInfo

The blades of a mesh: [{blade, caps, walls, points, root (world), thickness, offset, localTranslateZ, base: {...}}].

**Objects:** mesh

Not undoable.

### bladeExtrudeRanges

A range around the extrude values the meshes' blades use now: their mean, give or take spread. Returns {thickness: [low, high], offset: [...], localTranslateZ: [...]}.

**Objects:** meshes (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spread` |  | float | `0.3` | Fraction either side of the mean. |

Not undoable.

### deleteBladeDeformers

Delete the deformers of a kind on the selection, and their handles. Returns how many went.

**Objects:** nodes (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `k` | str | `'bend'` | bend \| flare \| twist \| sine \| squash \| wave |

### randomizeBladeDeformers

Re-roll the amount of the deformers of a kind on the selection (found from a mesh, a component, a handle or the deformer), biased up the mesh by where their handles sit. Returns how many changed.

**Objects:** nodes (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `k` | str | `'bend'` | bend \| flare \| twist \| sine \| squash \| wave |
| `low` |  | float |  | Lowest amount; the kind's default range when not given. |
| `high` |  | float |  | Highest amount. |
| `bias` | `b` | float | `0.0` | Bias to top, -1 to 1. |
| `up` |  | str | `'Auto'` | Up axis: Auto follows the scene. One of `Auto`, `X`, `Y`, `Z`. |
| `seed` | `s` | int | `0` | 0 differs every run; any other number repeats. |
| `spin` |  | bool | `False` | Also spin each handle around the up axis. |

### randomizeBladeExtrude

Give every blade of the meshes random extrude values in the ranges given. Each blade is rebuilt from its root, so running it again rerolls rather than stacking. bias 1 gives the high end of a range to the blades nearest the top, -1 to the bottom ones, 0 is pure random. seed 0 differs every run. Returns {meshes, blades}.

**Objects:** meshes (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fields` |  | Any |  | {thickness: [low, high], offset: [low, high], localTranslateZ: [low, high]}; leave a field out to keep it. |
| `bias` | `b` | float | `0.0` | Bias to top, -1 to 1. |
| `up` |  | str | `'Auto'` | Up axis for the bias: Auto follows the scene. One of `Auto`, `X`, `Y`, `Z`. |
| `seed` | `s` | int | `0` | 0 differs every run; any other number repeats. |

### resetBladeExtrude

Put every blade of the meshes back to the values it was extruded with. Returns the blade count.

**Objects:** meshes (default the selection)

### selectBladeFaces

Select the faces the blades grew from, which are their caps now, or with stems=True every face a blade made, caps and walls, down to the ring it stands on. Worked out from the mesh each time. Returns the face count.

**Objects:** meshes (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stems` |  | bool | `False` | Whole stems rather than caps. |

### setBladeExtrude

Set the extrude values of blades of one mesh directly, every blade by default. Fields not given keep their value.

**Objects:** mesh

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `blades` |  | list |  | Blade ids; default every blade. |
| `thickness` | `t` | float |  | cm. |
| `offset` | `o` | float |  | cm. |
| `localTranslateZ` | `ltz` | float |  | cm. |

Rasterise a leaf mesh's UV shells into <name>_opacity.png, a cutout mask for the leaf material. Returns the path.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preset` | `p` | str |  | Preset the settings start from (built in or saved); defaults when not given. |
| `settings` | `s` | Any |  | {"section.name": value} overrides on top of the preset, lengths in metres ("trunk.height": 6.0). |
| `leaf` | `l` | Any |  | Leaf mesh(es), densest first for detail levels; a list or a space separated string. |

Not undoable.

### treePresets

Preset names, built in first then saved ones.

Not undoable.

### treePresetSettings

A preset's full settings, lengths in metres.

**Objects:** preset

Not undoable.

### treeRebuild

Rebuild a stamped tree from the settings it carries, as <name>_rebuilt. Without its leaf mesh it grows the trunk alone. Returns the new tree.

**Objects:** tree (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `n` | str |  | Name of the rebuilt tree. |

### treeSavePreset

Save settings as a preset in the preferences. Built in names are refused.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preset` | `p` | str |  | Preset the settings start from (built in or saved); defaults when not given. |
| `settings` | `s` | Any |  | {"section.name": value} overrides on top of the preset, lengths in metres ("trunk.height": 6.0). |

Not undoable.

### treeScatterLeaves

Copy the leaf mesh over the canopy meshes, bending each copy onto the curvature and writing its shading into the leaf colour set (R exposure, G per leaf, B per bunch). Without leaf= and canopy= the selection is the canopy with the leaf last. Returns the leaves.

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preset` | `p` | str |  | Preset the settings start from (built in or saved); defaults when not given. |
| `settings` | `s` | Any |  | {"section.name": value} overrides on top of the preset, lengths in metres ("trunk.height": 6.0). |
| `leaf` | `l` | Any |  | Leaf mesh(es), densest first for detail levels; a list or a space separated string. |
| `canopy` | `c` | Any |  | Canopy mesh(es) to scatter over; a list or a space separated string. |
| `name` | `n` | str | `'leaves'` | Name. |

### treeSettings

The settings, sources and preset stored on a tree: {tree, values, sources, preset}, or null when the selection is no tree.

**Objects:** tree (default the selection)

Not undoable.

Not undoable.

### treeTextureSet

Make native texture sets for a tree instead of handing the palette to Painter: <name>_Bark (the species' bark tones over cavity, edges and AO) and <name>_Leaves (the season's leaf tones over the leaf colour set: R exposure, G per leaf, B per bunch), on the trunk and leaf materials, with a bake project from the export when there is one. Returns {sets, bakeProject, season, species, warnings}.

**Objects:** tree (default the selection)

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preset` | `p` | str |  | Preset the settings start from (built in or saved); defaults when not given. |
| `settings` | `s` | Any |  | {"section.name": value} overrides on top of the preset, lengths in metres ("trunk.height": 6.0). |
| `name` |  | str |  | Base name of the sets (<name>_Bark, <name>_Leaves); the tree's by default. |
| `season` |  | str | `'summer'` | Leaf palette: spring, summer, autumn or lateAutumn. |
| `target` |  | str | `'unreal'` | Bake target and export preset. |
| `bake` |  | bool | `True` | Make the bake project when the tree is exported. |
| `replace` |  | bool | `False` | Replace texture sets of those names. |
